name: 开关水龙头

source.relationship: 拆分子任务，需核验实际关节动作

original_success.scope: whole original task, not the selected standalone grasp subtask
original_success.description: Use the left hand to first place the spoon into the mug, use the right hand to place the mug under the faucet, use the left hand to open the faucet to fill the mug and then close it, and use the right hand to place the mug onto the tray.
original_success.code_note: Executed constants in reviewed evaluator: joint_0 open >=1.0 and close <0.52; header comment has stale 1.5/0.2. Mug must remain under spout through cycle. This is a state proxy, not verified fluid simulation

adaptation_protocol.changes: extract selected manipulation stage; define independent initial state and end condition
